reformulation: Fixed-column (constant) elimination plus box-certified row redundancy removal, not a reencoding: 595 columns proved constant (19 original bounds, 487 binary threshold indicators, 89 Boolean gate outputs) have their terms substituted and their contributions folded into RHS, and 2,249 proven-redundant rows are deleted; 11,659/18,442 -> 11,064/16,193 vars/rows, nonzeros incl. objective 54,663 -> 48,667, objective and every other row unchanged.
claim_class: exact constant-extension affine bijection: 3 directional claims (forward integer mode, reverse integer mode, reverse with both integrality flags off = objective-preserving target-LP inclusion), objective Equal, projection = the 11,064 retained coordinates; forward LP equivalence is not claimed and would be false.
claims: 3 claims over one map pair (tools/prepare_test25.py:56): forward source->target with integer=True, reverse with integer=True, reverse with integer=False; obligations_by_claim 72,085 / 75,524 / 52,825 = 200,434 total (cases/test25/preparation.json counts).

Each claim carries a Return map (11,064 coordinates forward, 11,659 reverse), one check per output-coordinate bound, one integrality fact per integer output coordinate, one check per output row, the objective relation 'Equal', the 11,064 projection identities and the full inverse identity on every input coordinate.

Forward rows are discharged as Lin over the source row ref plus the proved constant equalities; reverse rows 16,193 by row_ref equality against the substituted target row and 2,249 by box activity (Le) or an EqPair of two boxes (Eq).

Constant proofs are block-local and order-dependent: all 595 equalities sit in block 0; audit.json lists the 89 gate constants after their input constants (verified 89/89), and the builder cancels only already-proved fixed columns (tools/prepare_test25.py:49).
4 mutated certificates are required to be INVALID (cases/test25/preparation.json negative_checks): missing_binary_domain, missing_threshold_bound, wrong_recovery, missing_inverse, each exit 2.

Claim spec keys: reverse (bool), input_integers, output_integers, objective ('Equal'), projection (11,064 [input,output] coordinate pairs), inverse (0 = opposing claim index, or None).

Certified row removal by exact box activity: 892 rows redundant before substitution, 2,249 after substituting the 595 constants, subsuming all 54 exact duplicate groups; then hand-serialized the target MPS (2,734,982 B) and re-parsed it against the in-memory candidate.

Hard-codes the case shape (line 15) and rebuilds the source-to-target column map by name (line 16) with per-column equality asserts (line 18); every claim's checks are appended by hand (lines 57-72) and the projection list is rebuilt per claim (line 74).
Negative checks mutate raw step JSON by searching step keys (lines 96-101), e.g. next(s['Cases'] for s in bad['blocks'][0]['steps'])['integer']=None and ['Lin']['terms'].pop().
friction: Enumeration evidence is unusable to the kernel: the agent proved 487 constants by exhaustive domain tables (915,061 values) and gate outputs by 27,992 truth-table assignments, but the certificate must re-derive each as a local branch, and the rule can be unavailable - line 36 asserts 'wrong binary value needs stronger refutation'.

Supporting rows exist only in the agent's audit, never in the model: the preparer iterates d['rows'] (lines 33, 44) and never searches the matrix, so a compiler re-deriving edits must rediscover the (x,b) linking pairs and gate signatures itself.
Constant scheduling is inherited from audit.json order rather than computed: the requirement that gate proofs follow their input constants (verified 89/89) is only implicit in the record order.

The request restates one identical list three times: the 11,064-pair identity projection is 400,083 of the 400,415 request bytes (99.9%); claims cannot reference a shared projection or check list once.

The target is built outside the API: a 2,734,982-byte hand-serialized MPS, canonicalized afterwards, then matched back to the source by variable name and asserted equal column-by-column (forward row checks also key on the source row of the same name, line 71).
